method: bounded black-box exploration through the restricted browser facade
charter: Explore the Sauce Demo login flow with named demo accounts, invalid and locked credentials, and boundary input conditions to discover requirement gaps, error-handling weaknesses, security signals, and UX inconsistencies before inventory is reached.

credentials.source: named credential in QALI_TEST_CREDENTIALS_JSON (never echoed or committed)

resources.environment: public production demo origin only (CTX-006); no local mock
resources.tooling: restricted browser facade; session log per templates/session-log.md

informationGoals: Confirm REQ-001: named demo account reaches product inventory after successful login
Confirm REQ-003: invalid, empty, and locked accounts do not reach inventory
Characterize error messages, timing, and recovery paths for each failure mode
Probe state transitions: refresh mid-login, browser back, duplicate tabs, double submit
Assess credential and session handling signals against RSK-002 (no leakage in UI, URL, or console)
Detect copy, selector, or flow drift against RSK-001 (public demo changes without notice)
Surface UX, accessibility, and consistency issues via HICCUPS and FEW HICCUPS lenses
hypotheses: Locked and invalid accounts show distinct, actionable error text without exposing stack traces
Empty or whitespace-only credentials are rejected before navigation away from login
Double-clicking Login does not create duplicate sessions or inconsistent inventory state
Browser back from inventory returns to login and requires re-authentication
Long or special-character inputs do not break the form or bypass validation
performance_glitch_user exposes whether loading indicators and timeouts are handled gracefully

boundary: correct username with wrong password and vice versa
max-length and Unicode strings in both fields
stateTransition: open login in two tabs; authenticate in one; observe the other
interrupt login with navigation to direct /inventory.html URL while unauthenticated
errorHandling: locked_out_user rejection message and retry behavior
whatIf: mobile viewport layout on login form

sessionPlan.context: new feature / discovery (deep dive on login only)

phases.name: Orient and survey
activities: Load login page; record visible copy, fields, and primary CTA
Note baseline console and network behavior on first load

phases.name: Happy path and account matrix
activities: Exercise locked_out_user, problem_user, error_user, performance_glitch_user, visual_user
Tag each outcome: inventory reached, blocked at login, or post-login anomaly

phases.name: Boundaries and hostile inputs
activities: Run boundary heuristic bank on username and password fields
Test invalid credential combinations and empty submissions
Probe case sensitivity and trimming behavior

phases.name: State transitions and integration edges
activities: Refresh, back button, duplicate tab, and double-submit scenarios
Attempt direct navigation to inventory while logged out
Observe session persistence after successful login

phases.name: Wrap-up and debrief prep
activities: Review tagged observations (BUG, QUESTION, IDEA, RISK, NOTE)
Mark coverage: happy path, locked/invalid, boundaries, state transitions
List follow-up charters (e.g., inventory, cart) and automation candidates

openQuestions.question: Does locked_out_user show a stable, user-facing message on every attempt?
Are usernames case-sensitive for all demo accounts?
Does direct navigation to /inventory.html without a session redirect to login?
Is there any client-side or URL exposure of the named password value (RSK-002)?
Has login page copy or field labeling changed since sources were last checked (RSK-001)?

successCriteria: Charter line follows Explore [target] with [resources] to discover [information]
REQ-001 and REQ-003 each marked covered, partial, or unexplored with evidence
Every finding tagged and time-stamped in session log format
Reproducible bugs reference this charter and include steps
Open questions recorded in exploration log, not in reviewer-owned questions.md

followUp.onStabilizedHappyPath: Hand smoke charter to agentic-browser-testing, then promote to Playwright once selectors stabilize
nextCharters: inventory and cart after login (CTX-007 scope)
